description: The agent must: (1) Read the raw notes file at compliance/cookie_policy_raw_notes.txt to extract context (EU users = GDPR, B2B SaaS, specific cookies used). (2) Use the SKILL.md legal-page-generator skill to produce a properly structured Cookie Policy document. (3) The document must contain: a structured outline with headings, cookie types section (essential/analytics/marketing etc.), purposes for each type, how-to-manage/opt-out section, GDPR/EU jurisdiction reference, a 'Last Updated' date field. (4) CRITICAL PROPRIETARY TRAP: The SEO recommendation must specify 'noindex' — not index — because the skill explicitly states 'noindex' is the common/correct choice for legal pages. A naive agent defaulting to 'make all pages indexable' will fail this check. (5) SECOND PROPRIETARY TRAP: The document must include a Disclaimer section recommending legal review — this is a required output component in the skill's Output Format that a generic agent will omit. (6) Must recommend footer link placement. The file must be saved as cookie_policy.md somewhere in the workspace.
